name: tc__start
semantics: THINK C application entry (JT entry 0). clr.w 0xA4A; A6=0; D6='STRS'; tc__load_STRS (string-literal block, base in A4, stored at 0x10004); tc__init_globals (DATA/ZERO/DREL); tc__install_trap_patches (LoadSeg/ExitToShell); tc__call_STI (C++ static ctors); calls main via JT with argc=1 and argv/envp pointers built on the stack; after main returns: A5=CurrentA5, jsr 0x6C(A5) exit hook, ExitToShell. Never returns.

name: tc__call_STI
semantics: If the JT offset stored at 0x1000C is non-zero, jsr through it (A5+offset) to tc__run_STI (C++ static constructors). No args.

name: tc__LoadSeg_reloc_patch
semantics: Head of the _LoadSeg (A9F0) patch: saves D0-D7/A0-A4, D7=segment number (word at 0x3C(SP), the LoadSeg argument), sets byte 0xA5E; GetResource('CODE',seg); if bit7 of first code byte is set (clears it = relocate once): saves handle state (tc__save_handle_state), HLock, GetResource('CREL',seg), tc__restore_handle_state, tc__relocate with A2=segment base. Missing resource -> SysError(15). Returns into the patch block which then jumps to the original LoadSeg.

name: tc__init_globals
semantics: Initialises the A5 globals area: A1=(CurStackBase 0x908) .. A5. Copies words from 'DATA' 0 into the globals; whenever a copied word is 0, reads a count word N from 'ZERO' 0 and additionally writes N zero bytes. Releases DATA and ZERO, GetResource('DREL',0) and falls through into tc__relocate with A2=A5.

name: tc__relocate
semantics: Register args: A0=relocation resource handle (DREL/CREL), A2=base. For each 16-bit word w in the handle (GetHandleSize/2 words): if bit0 set (cleared) add the STRS base (long at 0x10004) else add A5 to the long at A2+(signed)w. ReleaseResource(A0). Clobbers D0-D2,A0.

name: tc__save_handle_state
semantics: D3.b = HGetState(A3) (on 64K ROM, ROM85<0: D3.b = master-pointer high byte *A3). A0=A3.

name: tc__restore_handle_state
semantics: HSetState(A3, D3.b) (on 64K ROM: *A3 = D3.b).

name: tc__switch_word_list
semantics: Switch helper (jsr, never returns normally). D0.w = selector. Inline table after the jsr: word N-1, then N entries {word offset, word value}. Scans entries with dbeq comparing value with D0.w; on match (or when exhausted, the last entry is used = default) jumps to (address of that entry's offset word)+offset. If the chosen offset is 0 it loops forever (beq to itself). Clobbers D1,D2,A0. Not referenced by game code.

name: tc__switch_long_list
semantics: Like tc__switch_word_list but D0.l is compared against 32-bit values: table = word N-1, then N entries {word offset, long value}; target = entry address + offset; offset 0 -> infinite loop. Not referenced by game code.

name: tc__switch_range
semantics: Dense switch helper. D0.w = selector. Inline table: word lo, word hi, word default_off, word off[lo..hi]. If D0>hi or D0<lo (signed) uses default_off else off[D0-lo]; jumps to (address of the chosen word)+offset; offset 0 -> infinite loop. Not referenced by game code.

name: tc_lmul
semantics: 32x32->32 multiply (low 32 bits, sign-agnostic). Args in C order (a at 4(SP), b at 8(SP)) but CALLEE pops 8 bytes. D0=a*b. Preserves D1-D7 (D1 saved in the arg slot). Called via JT 0x42(A5).

name: tc_uldiv
semantics: Unsigned 32/32 divide, D0 = dividend/divisor (4(SP)=dividend, 8(SP)=divisor), callee pops 8. Preserves D1-D7. Divisor 0 -> divu zero-divide exception. JT 0x4A(A5).

name: tc_ulmod
semantics: Unsigned 32-bit remainder, D0 = dividend % divisor, callee pops 8, preserves D1-D7. JT 0x52(A5).

name: tc_ldiv
semantics: Signed 32/32 divide truncating toward zero, D0=quotient, callee pops 8, preserves D1-D7. JT 0x5A(A5).

name: tc_lmod
semantics: Signed remainder (sign of dividend, C99 semantics), callee pops 8, preserves D1-D7. JT 0x62(A5).

name: tc__ldivmod_regs
semantics: Register signed divmod: in D0=dividend, D1=divisor; out D0=quotient (trunc toward 0), D1=remainder (sign of dividend). Clobbers D2,D3,D7.

name: tc__uldivmod_regs
semantics: Register unsigned divmod: in D0=dividend, D1=divisor; out D0=quotient, D1=remainder. Clobbers D2,D3,D7 (D7=0xFFFF). Divisor>dividend -> D0=0,D1=dividend.

name: tc__load_STRS
semantics: Loads resource type D6 ('STRS', the string-literal/A4 data) id 0 and, if larger than one resource, continuation ids (each 0x7FFE bytes) into one block: single part -> ReserveMem, LoadResource, DetachResource, HLock; multi-part -> NewPtr + BlockMove of each part. A4 = data base. Sets byte 0xA5E. D0=1 ok, 0 on failure. (Trailing code at 0x103A0 disposes the block.)

name: tc__install_trap_patches
semantics: NewPtr(0x18) (NewPtrSys on 64K ROM) stored at 0x68(A5); patches _LoadSeg (A9F0) with stub {jsr tc__LoadSeg_reloc_patch; jmp oldLoadSeg} and _ExitToShell (A9F4) with {jsr 0x1004C (A5=CurrentA5; jsr 0x6C(A5)); jmp oldExitToShell}.

name: tc__remove_trap_patches
semantics: Default 0x6C(A5) exit hook: restores original LoadSeg/ExitToShell addresses saved in the 0x68(A5) block and DisposePtr's it.

name: tc_malloc
semantics: THINK C malloc. size<15000: tc__malloc_small((short)size) from 15008-byte pools (block = 2-byte header ~blocksize + data, blocksize=(size+3)&~1). size>0x800000 -> NULL. Else NewPtr(size+2) (not cleared), header word 0xFFFF, returns ptr+2 (NULL if NewPtr fails). Memory is NOT zeroed.

name: tc_calloc
semantics: calloc: size>8MB -> NULL; size rounded up to even; total=nmemb*size (tc_lmul); total>8MB -> NULL; total<15000: tc__malloc_small + memset 0; else NewPtrClear(total+2) with 0xFFFF header. Unused by game.

name: tc_realloc
semantics: realloc: size>8MB -> NULL; p==NULL -> malloc(size); size==0 -> free(p), NULL. size rounded to even. Shrinks/grows small blocks in place when possible (merging following free blocks), large blocks via SetPtrSize; otherwise malloc+BlockMove(min(old,new))+free. Old size of small block = (~header)-2, of large = GetPtrSize-2. Unused by game.

name: tc_free
semantics: free: NULL ignored. header=~header at p-2: if it becomes 0 (was 0xFFFF, NewPtr block) DisposePtr(p-2), else the small block is now marked free (positive size); pools are never released.

name: tc__malloc_small
semantics: Small-block allocator: need=(size+3)&~1. Walks current pool (A5-0x1872) from rover (A5-0x186E) coalescing adjacent free blocks (header>0 = free size, header<0 = ~size allocated, -1 = pool end marker followed by next-pool link); first fit; splits; header=~need; returns block+2. When no pool fits, NewPtr(0x3AA0) new pool (circular list head A5-0x1876, last A5-0x187A). Returns 0 on failure.

name: tc_atexit
semantics: atexit: table of 34 entries x 6 bytes {fn, word flag} at A5-0x1862, count A5-0x186A; if count>33 return -1. Stores fn at entry[count++]. First time: saves the current 0x6C(A5) exit hook in A5-0x1796 and sets 0x6C(A5)=JT 0x13F2 (tc__exit_hook_all). Returns 0.

name: tc__atexit
semantics: THINK C _atexit: like atexit but sets entry flag=1 so fn also runs when the app quits via ExitToShell; first time patches ExitToShell (A9F4) -> tc__ExitToShell_patch (original saved A5-0x1792; on 64K ROM via a 6-byte jmp stub at A5-0x178E). Returns 0 / -1 if full. Called by MohawkInit.

name: tc__atexit_slot1
semantics: Temporarily sets the atexit count to 1, calls tc_atexit(fn) (stores into fixed slot 1), restores count. Used to register tc__stdio_exit_cleanup.

name: tc__atexit_slot0
semantics: Temporarily sets the atexit count to 0, calls tc__atexit(fn) (fixed slot 0, runs also on ExitToShell), restores count. Used to register tc__close_all_files.

name: tc_exit
semantics: exit(status): status ignored; jsr through 0x6C(A5) hook (runs atexit handlers, restores traps) then ExitToShell. Never returns. Called by Terminate.

name: tc__exit
semantics: _exit: ExitToShell directly (patched ExitToShell still runs _atexit handlers). Used by raise() for SIG_DFL.

name: tc__exit_hook_all
semantics: Exit hook installed in 0x6C(A5) by atexit: tc__run_exit_handlers(1).

name: tc__ExitToShell_patch
semantics: ExitToShell patch installed by _atexit: tc__run_exit_handlers(0) (which restores the real ExitToShell) then ExitToShell.

name: tc__run_exit_handlers
semantics: Runs exit handlers slots 33..0 with A5 = saved A5 (tc__get_saved_A5): each non-NULL slot is cleared and called if all!=0 or its flag word!=0. all==0 also sets A5-0x1866=1 (console proc then does nothing). Disposes ExitToShell stub, restores original ExitToShell, then calls saved previous hook (A5-0x1796) or 0x6C(A5), and sets A5-0x1796 = tc__exit_nop.

name: tc__exit_nop
semantics: Empty function (rts); placeholder exit hook.

name: tc__A5_storage_addr
semantics: Returns in A1 the address (0x56838) of a 4-byte A5 save slot embedded in the code segment (bsr trick).

name: tc__pop_A1
semantics: Internal: movea.l (SP)+,A1; rts (helper of tc__A5_storage_addr).

name: tc__save_A5
semantics: Stores A5 into the code-segment slot at 0x56838 (clobbers A1).

name: tc__get_saved_A5
semantics: D0 = A5 value saved at 0x56838 (clobbers A1).

name: tc_atoi
semantics: atoi: sscanf(s, fmt@A5-0x178A (initialised-data string, presumably "%d"), &v); returns 32-bit v, or 0 if sscanf<=0. Leading isspace skipped, optional sign, decimal; overflow clamps to LONG_MAX/LONG_MIN (errno=34). Called by midi code.

name: tc_atol
semantics: atol(s) = strtol(s, NULL, 10). Unused by game.

name: tc_strtol
semantics: strtol via sscanf(s, fmt@A5-0x1786, base, &val, &n) (THINK '?' flag takes the base from the arg list, '%n' gives chars consumed). On no conversion val=n=0. If endp: *endp=s+n (s if nothing parsed). Skips isspace, sign, base 0 => auto 0x/0 prefix, base 16 accepts 0x; overflow -> LONG_MAX/LONG_MIN, errno(A5-0x155E)=34. Called by GetEditTextNumericValue.

name: tc_strtoul
semantics: strtoul, same scheme with fmt@A5-0x177E (unsigned conversion). Per decompiled scanf engine a '-' with nonzero value yields 0 and errno=34 (unverified). Unused by game.

name: tc__filbuf
semantics: getc slow path: fp->cnt(0x14)=0; tc__checkfp; if ungetc pushback active (byte1 bit7): restore saved buffer (cnt=saved 0x0C, pos+=cnt, ptr=buf) else tc__stdio_prep_buffer + proc(fp,0) (fill), error -> -1. Then cnt--, returns *ptr++ (0..255).

name: tc__flsbuf
semantics: putc slow path: if not yet writing (flag bit3): checkfp, append mode -> pos=EOF(0x1C), prep buffer, line-buffered(0x20!=0) -> cnt=1, set bit3. Stores (char)c, flushes when buffer full or (line-buffered and c<' ' and...) per code; returns (unsigned char)c or -1 on flush error.

name: tc__stdio_prep_buffer
semantics: ptr=buf, cnt=bufsize; if refnum(0x06)>0 and bufsize>1: cnt -= pos % bufsize (align window); pos(0x18) += cnt.

name: tc__stdio_flush_buffer
semantics: pos -= cnt; if dirty (bit3): cnt=ptr-buf, ptr=buf, clear bit3, result=proc(fp,1) (write). Then tc__stdio_reset_buffer. Returns proc result (0 ok).

name: tc__stdio_reset_buffer
semantics: ptr=buf+bufsize, cnt=0, clear pushback flag (byte1 bit7).

name: tc_freopenc
semantics: THINK C console: makes stream `to` a console stream (sharing from's window if from!=NULL, else creates a console window via tc__console_new_window; on first use initialises the Toolbox if byte 0x8F2 set). fclose(to) first, refnum=-1, 512-byte buffer, proc=tc__console_proc, registers tc__stdio_exit_cleanup in atexit slot 1. Returns to or NULL.

name: tc_cgotoxy
semantics: Console: cursor col=x-1, row=y-1 (1-based). Unused by game.

name: tc_cgetxy
semantics: Console: *x=col+1, *y=row+1. Unused.

name: tc_ccleos
semantics: Console: clear to end of screen. Unused.

name: tc_ccleol
semantics: Console: clear to end of line. Unused.

name: tc_csettabs
semantics: Console: tab width (clamped to 1..ncols). Unused.

name: tc_csetmode
semantics: Console: 0=C_RAW,1=C_CBREAK,2=C_NOECHO,3=C_ECHO (mode bits 7/6/5 of A5-0x16F6). Unused.

name: tc_cinverse
semantics: Console: on -> installs QDProcs with textProc tc__console_inverse_textProc (chars with bit7 drawn inverted); off -> removes. Unused.

name: tc_cshow
semantics: Console: SelectWindow if not front, ShowWindow.

name: tc_chide
semantics: Console: HideWindow. Unused.

name: tc_cecho2file
semantics: Console: echo output to file (fopen mode A5-0x16CC if append else A5-0x16CA).

name: tc_cecho2printer
semantics: Console: echo output to a tmpfile printed on close. Unused.

name: tc__console_init_std
semantics: Lazily attaches stdin/stdout/stderr (flag bit7 of their byte0) to one console window via tc_freopenc; optional startup echo file (A5-0x1722).

name: tc__console_InitToolbox
semantics: MaxApplZone, 10x MoreMasters, InitGraf(new 0xCE-byte QD globals), InitFonts/Windows/TEInit/Dialogs/Menus, Apple/File/Edit menus, DrawMenuBar, FlushEvents, InitCursor; sets A5-0x16F2=1.

name: tc__console_poll_event
semantics: Console event pump: feeds pending pasted text as keystrokes, else SystemTask/GetNextEvent/SystemEvent, handles menu bar (DA open, Quit -> exit(0), Edit -> SystemEdit) (console internal).

name: tc__console_new_window
semantics: Creates the console window (NewWindow, font/size from globals, TENew, rows/cols), installs fake DA driver for event routing; returns WindowPtr (console internal).

name: tc__console_close_window
semantics: Disposes console window/TE if no other stream uses it (console internal).

name: tc__console_end_echo
semantics: Closes the echo file (A5-0x16FA), printing it first if echo-to-printer (console internal).

name: tc__console_select
semantics: checkfp; flushes all other dirty streams on the same window; returns fp's WindowPtr (0x20) (console internal).

name: tc__stdio_exit_cleanup
semantics: atexit slot 1: fflush dirty console streams; if console active and A5-0x1762 set, retitles window and waits for a keypress ('press return'); then fclose all 15 streams.

name: tc__console_proc
semantics: Console stream proc: cmd 0 = read line (event loop until input), 1 = write buffer (tc__console_write), 2 = close; Cmd-. -> raise(SIGINT=4). Returns 0/-1.

name: tc__console_inverse_textProc
semantics: QuickDraw textProc (Pascal, pops 14): draws runs with StdText; chars with bit7 set are drawn (char&0x7F) in TextMode 4 (inverted), then TextMode 0.

name: tc__console_clear_from_line
semantics: Console internal: blank lines from `line` to bottom, col=0.

name: tc__console_clear_eol_impl
semantics: Console internal: TEDelete from cursor to end of line.

name: tc__console_write
semantics: Console internal: output n chars handling BEL(7) BS(8) TAB(9) LF(10) VT(11) FF(12) CR(13); checks event queue for Cmd-. (sets A5-0x16F0).

name: tc__console_put_text
semantics: Console internal: puts printable run into TE text, wrapping lines.

name: tc__console_input_delete
semantics: Console internal: delete chars from pending input line (TEDelete/TECopy) (low confidence).

name: tc__console_input_insert
semantics: Console internal: insert typed char into input line (TEKey/Munger) (low confidence).

name: tc__console_fill_scratch
semantics: Console internal: SetHandleSize scratch handle and fill (low confidence).

name: tc__console_te_insert_at
semantics: Console internal: TEPaste scratch at offset (low confidence).

name: tc__console_te_activate
semantics: Console internal: set selection/caret and TEActivate.

name: tc__console_te_deactivate
semantics: Console internal: TEDeactivate; returns *TEHandle.

name: tc__console_trim_text
semantics: Console internal: drops scrolled-off lines from TE text (Munger, TECalText).

name: tc__console_resize_te
semantics: Console internal: recompute TE rects after resize/zoom.

name: tc__console_enter_port
semantics: Console internal: save port, select console window, process pending update (BeginUpdate/TEUpdate).

name: tc__console_leave_port
semantics: Console internal: restore port/current window.

name: tc__console_set_window
semantics: Console internal: switch current console window state (copies 0x2E-byte state record).

name: tc__console_lock_text
semantics: Console internal: HLock TE text, returns pointer.

name: tc__console_unlock_text
semantics: Console internal: HUnlock TE text.

name: tc__console_newline
semantics: Console internal: newline: echo line to file, scroll (ScrollRect), handle pause (GetOSEvent) .

name: tc__console_install_driver
semantics: Console internal: builds DA driver header handle (open/close=tc__console_driver_noop, control=tc__console_driver_control) and DrvrInstall; returns refnum used as windowKind.

name: tc__console_driver_noop
semantics: Console fake-driver open/close entry (rts).

name: tc__console_driver_control
semantics: Console fake-driver control routine: accEvent/accRun/accCut/Copy/Paste/Clear/accMenu dispatch (low confidence).

name: tc__console_idle
semantics: Console internal: TEIdle and I-beam cursor when over window.

name: tc__console_mousedown
semantics: Console internal: mouse-down dispatch (zoom/grow/content).

name: tc__console_zoom
semantics: Console internal: TrackBox/ZoomWindow.

name: tc__console_grow
semantics: Console internal: GrowWindow/SizeWindow.

name: tc__console_content_click
semantics: Console internal: TEClick selection handling.

name: tc__console_edit_command
semantics: Console internal: cut/copy/paste/interrupt/quit commands (low confidence).

name: tc__console_key
semantics: Console internal: processes a typed key (line editing, RAW/CBREAK/ECHO modes, EOF).

name: tc__console_cut
semantics: Console internal: cut (copy + delete selection of input).

name: tc__console_copy
semantics: Console internal: TECopy, ZeroScrap, PutScrap('TEXT').

name: tc__console_paste
semantics: Console internal: GetScrap('TEXT') into handle A5-0x1706 fed as keystrokes.

name: tc__console_print_echo
semantics: Console internal: PrOpen; tc__console_print_file; PrClose.

name: tc__console_print_file
semantics: Console internal: prints echo file via Printing Manager (PrJobDialog, PrOpenDoc, DrawText per line).

name: tc_isalnum
semantics: isalnum: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0xD0 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game.

name: tc_isalpha
semantics: isalpha: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0xC0 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game.

name: tc_iscntrl
semantics: iscntrl: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0x03 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game.

name: tc_isdigit
semantics: isdigit: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0x10 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game.

name: tc_isgraph
semantics: isgraph: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0xD8 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game.

name: tc_isupper
semantics: isupper: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0x80 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game. NOTE upper/lower naming inferred from tolower/toupper (0x80=upper,0x40=lower); source order suggests the opposite pair could be swapped.

name: tc_isprint
semantics: isprint: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0xDC (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game.

name: tc_ispunct
semantics: ispunct: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0x08 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game.

name: tc_isspace
semantics: isspace: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0x06 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game.

name: tc_islower
semantics: islower: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0x40 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game. NOTE upper/lower naming inferred from tolower/toupper (0x80=upper,0x40=lower); source order suggests the opposite pair could be swapped.

name: tc_isxdigit
semantics: isxdigit: returns (long)(signed char)__ctype[(unsigned char)c] & 0x30 (ctype table at A5-0x165E, filled from DATA). Unused by game.

name: tc_tolower
semantics: Returns c^0x20 if __ctype[(uchar)c]&0x80 else c (whole 32-bit c returned). Upper/lower naming inferred. Unused.

name: tc_toupper
semantics: Returns c^0x20 if __ctype[(uchar)c]&0x40 else c. Unused.

name: tc_remove
semantics: PBDelete(name as Pascal str, vRefNum 0); error -> errno=OSErr, -1; else 0. Unused.

name: tc_rename
semantics: PBRename; -1/errno on error. Unused.

name: tc_tmpfile
semantics: tmpnam into local buffer, fopen(name, mode@A5-0x1536), sets temp flag (byte0 bit0, deleted on close).

name: tc_tmpnam
semantics: tmpnam(buf or static A5-0x1556) via tc__tmpnam_impl. Unused.

name: tc__tmpnam_impl
semantics: Builds Pascal name with sprintf(buf+1, fmt@A5-0x152C, prefix, ++*counter) (counter wraps 9999->1) until PBGetFInfo returns fnfErr; converts to C string in place; returns buf or 0 if counter wrapped to start.

name: tc_fopen
semantics: fopen: tc__find_free_file then freopen(name,mode,fp).

name: tc_freopen
semantics: Parses mode: 'r' (perm 1 fsRdPerm, flags 0), 'w' (perm 2, flags 3=create|trunc), 'a' (perm 2, flags 9=create|append); 'b' -> flags|0x10 (binary), '+' -> perm 3; other -> errno 22, NULL. Calls tc__fopen_impl.

name: tc__fopen_impl
semantics: fclose(fp); PBCreate if oflags&1 (success clears trunc bit; dupFNErr ok unless oflags&4); PBOpen (error -> errno, delete if just created, NULL); refnum->0x06; trunc -> PBSetEOF(0) else PBGetEOF -> 0x1C; append -> bit1 & pos=EOF; binary -> bit6; setvbuf(fp,NULL,_IOFBF,512); proc=tc__file_proc; new file -> tc__set_file_type; registers tc__close_all_files in _atexit slot 0. Returns fp.

name: tc__set_file_type
semantics: If file created: PBSetFInfo type = (binary? global A5-0x1524 : 'TEXT'), creator = A5-0x1520.

name: tc__close_all_files
semantics: fclose all 15 FILE slots (A5-0x151C, 0x28 bytes each).

name: tc__file_proc
semantics: Disk file stream proc. cmd 0: PBRead(cnt bytes at absolute pos-cnt) into buffer, eofErr with data -> ok, no data -> EOF bit5, -1; text mode converts CR->LF. cmd 1: extends EOF if needed (PBSetEOF), text mode converts LF->CR IN PLACE, PBWrite, updates EOF field. cmd 2: tc__file_close. Errors set bit4 (error), errno=OSErr, return -1.

name: tc__file_close
semantics: PBClose; temp files (bit0) are deleted (PBDelete / PBHDelete for HFS); PBFlushVol. Returns OSErr.

name: tc__replace_char
semantics: Replaces every byte `from` with `to` in buf[0..n) (uses memchr).

name: tc_fseek
semantics: Only for refnum>0 else errno=19,-1. fflush; SEEK_CUR adds logical pos, SEEK_END adds EOF field (0x1C), other whence -> -1; negative -> errno 22,-1; pos=result, clears EOF bit; 0. No trap (pos used on next read/write).

name: tc_fsetpos
semantics: fseek(fp,*pos,SEEK_SET). Unused.

name: tc_rewind
semantics: fseek(fp,0,0); clears error bit4.

name: tc_ftell
semantics: refnum>0 ? pos-cnt : (errno=19,-1). Unused.

name: tc_fgetpos
semantics: *pos = pos-cnt; 0 (or errno 19,-1). Unused.

name: tc_fwrite
semantics: fwrite: total=size*n (0 -> 0); large aligned unbuffered-style writes go straight through proc(1); otherwise copies via buffer / putc. Returns n - ceil(unwritten/size). Used by vfprintf for field output.

name: tc_fgets
semantics: fgets: n<1 -> NULL; reads up to n-1 chars, stops after '\n' (kept); EOF with nothing read -> NULL; NUL-terminates; returns s.

name: tc_gets
semantics: gets from stdin (A5-0x151C), newline not stored. Unused.

name: tc_fgetc
semantics: fgetc: cnt-- ? *ptr++ : tc__filbuf(fp). Returns 0..255 or -1.

name: tc_getc
semantics: Function version of getc (same as fgetc). Unused.

name: tc__find_free_file
semantics: Returns first of the 12 non-std FILE slots (A5-0x14A4..) with refnum 0, else errno=24 and NULL.

name: tc_fprintf
semantics: fprintf -> tc_vfprintf(fp, fmt, &args). Unused.

name: tc_printf
semantics: printf -> tc_vprintf. Unused.

name: tc_vprintf
semantics: tc_vfprintf(stdout=A5-0x14F4, fmt, va).

name: tc_fscanf
semantics: fscanf -> tc_vfscanf. Unused.

name: tc_scanf
semantics: scanf -> tc_vscanf. Unused.

name: tc_vscanf
semantics: tc_vfscanf(stdin=A5-0x151C, fmt, va).

name: tc_setbuf
semantics: setvbuf(fp, buf, buf?_IOFBF(0):_IONBF(2), 512).

name: tc_setvbuf
semantics: mode 0=_IOFBF,1=_IOLBF,2=_IONBF (buffer = 1 byte at fp+4); size 0 with mode<2 -> -1; buf NULL -> malloc(size) (flag bit2); frees previous malloc'd buffer; sets buf/size, reset buffer; 0 or -1.

name: tc_fflush
semantics: fflush(fp) -> flush_buffer; fflush(NULL) flushes all writing streams, -1 if any failed.

name: tc_fclose
semantics: Clears bit7; if refnum!=0: flush, proc(fp,2), free malloc'd buffer, memset(fp,0,0x28). Returns 0 or -1.

name: tc_memcpy
semantics: Forward byte-by-byte copy of n bytes (n==0 ok, overlapping regions copied forward), returns dst.

name: tc_memmove
semantics: Overlap-safe byte copy: if src>dst forward else backward; returns dst.

name: tc_memcmp
semantics: Unsigned byte compare; returns exactly 0, 1 (a>b) or -1 (a<b) as 32-bit long.

name: tc_memchr
semantics: Finds first byte == (char)c (low byte of the 32-bit arg at 0xB(SP)) in n bytes; returns pointer or NULL.

name: tc_memset
semantics: Fills n bytes with (char)c (c is a 32-bit int, low byte used), returns s.

name: tc_vfprintf
semantics: THINK C printf engine. Flags - + space # 0; width/precision digits or '*' (32-bit int arg; negative '*' width -> left-justify); modifiers h (d/i: sign-extend low 16 bits; u/o/x/X: &0xFFFF; %hn stores 16-bit), l (no effect: int already 32-bit), L. ALL integer args are 32-bit (game code ext.l's 16-bit values before calling). %d %i %u %o %x %X %c %s %n %p %e %E %f %g %G %%. Ints: precision = min digits (default 1, '0' flag without precision pads to width incl. sign); precision 0 and value 0 -> no digits. '#': o -> leading 0, x/X -> '0x'/'0X' prefix even for 0. %p = %X with precision 8 (8 uppercase hex digits, no prefix). %s with precision uses memchr; %#s prints a Pascal string (length byte, precision limits). Floats are 10-byte SANE extended args (consumes 10 bytes), converted with SANE num2dec (max 19 sig digits); exponent >=2 digits; INF/NAN text. An unknown conversion character stops formatting and returns the count so far. Returns chars written or -1 on output error.

name: tc__printf_num2dec
semantics: SANE FX2DEC (Pack4 0x0B) of 10-byte extended x into Decimal record with decform{style,digits<=19}; retries with float style if result '?', strips trailing zeros (adjusting exponent), zero -> sig '0' exp 0, 'I'->"INF", 'N'->"NAN".

name: tc_qsort
semantics: qsort: stores base/size/cmp in globals (A5-0x1286/-0x1282/-0x127E) and runs index quicksort tc__isort(n, cmp_idx, swap_idx). Algorithm (tc__quicksort(lo,hi), hi exclusive): while hi-lo>1: i=lo,j=hi; loop{ do i++ while i<hi && cmp(i,lo)<0; do j-- while j>lo && cmp(j,lo)>0; if i<j {swap(i,j); continue loop} else break }; if j==lo {lo++; continue}; swap(lo,j); if (hi-1-j) > (j-lo) {recurse(lo,j); lo=j+1} else {recurse(j+1,hi); hi=j}. cmp(i,j)=cmp(base+i*size, base+j*size); swap exchanges size bytes. Not stable; tie order must follow this exact sequence. Used by resCloseFile.

name: tc__qsort_cmp_idx
semantics: Returns user_cmp(base+i*size, base+j*size).

name: tc__qsort_swap_idx
semantics: Swaps `size` bytes between element i and j (byte loop).

name: tc__isort
semantics: Stores index cmp/swap callbacks (A5-0x127A/-0x1276) and calls tc__quicksort(0, n).

name: tc__quicksort
semantics: Recursive index quicksort on [lo,hi), pivot = element lo; exact algorithm in tc_qsort semantics. Uses global A5-0x128A as i.

name: tc_vfscanf
semantics: THINK C scanf engine. Format whitespace skips input isspace (ctype&6); literal chars must match (mismatch -> ungetc & stop). '%': '*' suppress, width, '?' (base taken from next 32-bit arg, used by strtol), h (store short / %hf double), l (long = default 32-bit / %lf 10-byte extended), L (extended). d(10) i(0=auto) u o x X p(long) c(default width 1, no NUL) s [..] (scanset, ^, ranges) e f g E G (%f stores 4-byte float!) n (chars consumed, not counted). Integer overflow clamps (LONG_MIN/MAX or SHRT for h) with errno 34. Returns number of assignments, or -1 if input ended before the first conversion.

name: tc__scanset_clear
semantics: Clears 256-bit set at A5-0x126A; if arg!=0 sets {9..13,' '} and inverts (used by %s).

name: tc__scanset_add
semantics: Sets bit c in scan set.

name: tc__scanset_invert
semantics: Inverts the 256-bit scan set (no args).

name: tc__scanset_test
semantics: Returns nonzero if bit c set (EOF -1 maps to byte -1/8...).

name: tc__scanf_dec2num
semantics: SANE FDEC2X (Pack4) Decimal -> dest in SANE format (0=extended,0x800=double,0x1000=single); overflow/underflow -> errno 34 and INF/0 result.

name: tc_signal
semantics: sig must be 1..6 else errno 22,-1; swaps handler in table A5-0x124A, returns old.

name: tc_raise
semantics: sig 1..6 else -1/errno 22; handler 1 (SIG_IGN) ignored; else reset to 0 and: 0 (SIG_DFL) -> _exit; else handler(sig). Returns 0.

name: tc__checkfp
semantics: If byte0 bit7 (std stream not yet attached) -> tc__console_init_std; if refnum==0 makes it a dummy stream (1-byte buffer at fp+4, proc=nullproc). Returns fp.

name: tc__c2pstr_copy
semantics: Copies C string to Pascal string at dst (length = strlen & 0xFF); returns dst.

name: tc__sscanf_fp_init
semantics: tc__string_fp_init(fp, str, strlen(str)); returns fp.

name: tc__sprintf_fp_init
semantics: tc__string_fp_init(fp, buf, -1) (unbounded), sets writing bit3; returns fp.

name: tc__string_fp_init
semantics: memset(fp,0,0x28); refnum=-1; ptr=p; cnt=cnt; proc=tc__stdio_nullproc.

name: tc__stdio_nullproc
semantics: Stream proc for string FILEs: returns -1.

name: tc_sprintf
semantics: sprintf -> tc_vsprintf(buf, fmt, &varargs). Varargs are 32-bit ints / pointers / 10-byte extended. Returns length; buf NUL-terminated (no bound).

name: tc_vsprintf
semantics: Builds string FILE on stack (cnt=-1), n=tc_vfprintf; if n>=0 buf[n]=0; returns n.

name: tc_sscanf
semantics: sscanf -> tc_vsscanf(str, fmt, &varargs).

name: tc_vsscanf
semantics: String FILE with cnt=strlen(str) then tc_vfscanf.

name: tc__fp_proc_fill
semantics: return fp->proc(fp, 0).

name: tc__fp_proc_flush
semantics: return fp->proc(fp, 1).

name: tc__fp_proc_close
semantics: return fp->proc(fp, 2).

name: tc_strcpy
semantics: Copies including NUL, returns dst.

name: tc_strcat
semantics: Appends src to dst, returns dst.

name: tc_strcmp
semantics: Unsigned char compare; returns exactly -1/0/1 (32-bit).

name: tc_strchr
semantics: First occurrence of (char)c (32-bit arg, low byte), c==0 finds terminator; NULL if none.

name: tc_strcspn
semantics: Standard strcspn. Unused.

name: tc_strpbrk
semantics: Standard strpbrk. Called by configFindFile.

name: tc_strrchr
semantics: Last occurrence of (char)c (terminator included). Unused.

name: tc_strspn
semantics: Standard strspn. Unused.

name: tc_strstr
semantics: Naive strstr; empty sub -> s. Unused.

name: tc_strtok
semantics: Standard strtok, saved pointer in A5-0x1206. Unused.

name: tc_strlen
semantics: Standard strlen (32-bit result).

name: tc_ungetc
semantics: ungetc: c==-1 -> -1. checkfp. If pushback mode active (byte1 bit7): cnt!=0 -> -1. Else if cnt==bufsize!=0 (nothing consumed): pos-=cnt, cnt=0, ptr=fp+6, set byte1 bit7 (1-byte pushback at fp+5; tc__filbuf later restores the window). Else if ptr==buf: memmove the cnt bytes to the end of the buffer. Then clear EOF bit5, cnt++, *--ptr=(char)c; returns (uchar)c.

name: tc__new_alloc
semantics: Allocator used by operator new: identical algorithm to tc_malloc but with its OWN pool list (globals A5-0x195C/-0x1958/-0x1960/-0x1964).

name: tc__new_free
semantics: Same as tc_free (used by operator delete).

name: tc__new_alloc_small
semantics: Small-block allocator for operator new pools (copy of tc__malloc_small with separate globals).

name: tc__lmul_stk
semantics: D0=4(SP), D1=8(SP) then falls into tc_lmul_d0d1. Caller pops. Unused.

name: tc_lmul_d0d1
semantics: Register multiply: D0 = D0*D1 (low 32 bits). Clobbers D1 and A0; D2 preserved. Symantec C++ helper (JT 0x13CA).

name: tc__ldiv_stk
semantics: D1=4(SP) (divisor), D0=8(SP) (dividend), falls into tc_ldiv_d0d1. Unused.

name: tc_ldiv_d0d1
semantics: Register signed divide: in D0=dividend, D1=divisor; out D0=quotient (trunc toward 0); D1 = quotient too (moved). Uses tc_lmod_d0d1. JT 0x13D2.

name: tc__uldiv_stk
semantics: D1=4(SP), D0=8(SP), falls into tc_uldiv_d0d1. Unused.

name: tc_uldiv_d0d1
semantics: Register unsigned divide: in D0=dividend, D1=divisor; out D0=D1=quotient. JT 0x13DA.

name: tc__lmod_stk
semantics: D1=4(SP), D0=8(SP), falls into tc_lmod_d0d1. Unused.

name: tc_lmod_d0d1
semantics: Register signed divmod: in D0=dividend, D1=divisor; out D0=remainder (sign of dividend), D1=quotient (trunc toward 0). Preserves D2-D7. JT 0x13E2 (used by Rnd etc. for %).

name: tc__ulmod_stk
semantics: D1=4(SP), D0=8(SP), falls into tc_ulmod_d0d1. Unused.

name: tc_ulmod_d0d1
semantics: Register unsigned divmod: in D0=dividend, D1=divisor; out D0=remainder, D1=quotient. Preserves D2-D4. Divisor 0 -> divu exception. JT 0x13EA.

name: tc_operator_delete
semantics: C++ operator delete(void*): tc__new_free(p). CALLEE pops 4 bytes.

name: tc_operator_new
semantics: C++ operator new(size_t): size 0 -> 2; p=tc__new_alloc(size); while p==NULL and new_handler (A5-0x1954) != NULL: call it and retry. Result in D0, CALLEE pops 4 bytes.

name: tc__run_STI
semantics: C++ static init: if '_STD' 0 exists -> stored at A5-0x194C and tc__run_STD registered with atexit; '_STI' 0: MoveHHi/HLock, calls A5+offset for each long in it, ReleaseResource.

name: tc__run_STD
semantics: Runs C++ static destructors: calls A5+offset for each long in the '_STD' resource, then releases it.

name: tc_CtoPstr
semantics: In-place C->Pascal string: shifts bytes right by one, s[0]=strlen&0xFF; returns s.

name: tc_PtoCstr
semantics: In-place Pascal->C string: shifts left by one, NUL-terminates; returns s.

name: tc_SysEnvirons
semantics: FUNCTION SysEnvirons(versReq; VAR theWorld): OSErr. Uses trap A090 if implemented; else fills the 16-byte record by hand (environsVersion 2, machineType from ROM, systemVersion 0, processor, hasFPU, hasColorQD, keyboard, atDrvrVersNum, sysVRefNum via working dir 'ERIK') and returns envNotPresent -5500. Result word at 10(SP) of caller frame (slot above args).

name: tc_Gestalt
semantics: FUNCTION Gestalt(selector; VAR response): OSErr. If _Gestalt (A1AD) implemented: trap, *response=A0, result D0. Else built-in table for 'vers','mach','sysv','proc','fpu ','qd  ','kbd ','atlk','mmu ','ram ','lram', other -> -5551.

name: tc_GetPtrSize
semantics: FUNCTION GetPtrSize(p): Size; negative (error) -> 0.

name: tc_GetHandleSize
semantics: FUNCTION GetHandleSize(h): Size; negative (error) -> 0.

name: tc_NGetTrapAddress
semantics: FUNCTION NGetTrapAddress(trapNum; tTyp: TrapType): LongInt. tTyp (byte) !=0 -> GetToolTrapAddress (A746) else GetOSTrapAddress (A346).

name: tc_PBOpen
semantics: FUNCTION PBOpen(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBClose
semantics: FUNCTION PBClose(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBControl
semantics: FUNCTION PBControl(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBGetVInfo
semantics: FUNCTION PBGetVInfo(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBGetEOF
semantics: FUNCTION PBGetEOF(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBSetEOF
semantics: FUNCTION PBSetEOF(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBSetFPos
semantics: FUNCTION PBSetFPos(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBOpenWD
semantics: FUNCTION PBOpenWD(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant (HFSDispatch A260/A660 selector 1); result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBCloseWD
semantics: FUNCTION PBCloseWD(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant (HFSDispatch A260/A660 selector 2); result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBHGetVol
semantics: FUNCTION PBHGetVol(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBGetFCBInfo
semantics: FUNCTION PBGetFCBInfo(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant (HFSDispatch A260/A660 selector 8); result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBGetCatInfo
semantics: FUNCTION PBGetCatInfo(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant (HFSDispatch A260/A660 selector 9); result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBSetCatInfo
semantics: FUNCTION PBSetCatInfo(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant (HFSDispatch A260/A660 selector 10); result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBHGetVInfo
semantics: FUNCTION PBHGetVInfo(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBHOpen
semantics: FUNCTION PBHOpen(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBHDelete
semantics: FUNCTION PBHDelete(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBHRename
semantics: FUNCTION PBHRename(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBHRstFLock
semantics: FUNCTION PBHRstFLock(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_PBHSetFLock
semantics: FUNCTION PBHSetFLock(pb; async: Boolean): OSErr. A0=pb, sync or async trap variant; result = D0.w (written to the slot above the args).

name: tc_FSOpen
semantics: FUNCTION FSOpen(fileName: Str255; vRefNum; VAR refNum): OSErr. PBOpenDF (HFSDispatch sel 0x1A) with ioPermssn 0 (fsCurPerm), ioVersNum 0, ioMisc 0; if paramErr (-50) falls back to PBOpen. *refNum = ioRefNum (written even on error).

name: tc_FSClose
semantics: FUNCTION FSClose(refNum): OSErr via PBClose.

name: tc_FSRead
semantics: FUNCTION FSRead(refNum; VAR count; buffPtr): OSErr. PBRead with ioReqCount=*count, ioPosMode 0 (fsAtMark), ioPosOffset 0; *count = ioActCount.

name: tc_FSWrite
semantics: FUNCTION FSWrite(refNum; VAR count; buffPtr): OSErr. PBWrite at mark; *count = ioActCount.

name: tc_GetVInfo
semantics: FUNCTION GetVInfo(drvNum; volName; VAR vRefNum; VAR freeBytes): OSErr. PBHGetVInfo(ioVRefNum=drvNum, ioVolIndex 0); *vRefNum=ioVRefNum; *freeBytes = (((ioVAlBlkSiz>>9) * (word)ioVFrBlk) << 9) (32-bit, mulu on low words).

name: tc_GetFInfo
semantics: FUNCTION GetFInfo(fileName; vRefNum; VAR fndrInfo): OSErr. PBGetFInfo (version 0, dirIndex 0), copies 16 bytes of ioFlFndrInfo (even on error).

name: tc_GetVol
semantics: FUNCTION GetVol(volName; VAR vRefNum): OSErr via PBGetVol.

name: tc_SetVol
semantics: FUNCTION SetVol(volName; vRefNum): OSErr via PBSetVol.

name: tc_Create
semantics: FUNCTION Create(fileName; vRefNum; creator; fileType): OSErr. PBCreate; if ok PBGetFInfo, set fdType/fdCreator, PBSetFInfo.

name: tc_SetFInfo
semantics: FUNCTION SetFInfo(fileName; vRefNum; fndrInfo): OSErr. PBGetFInfo, overwrite 16-byte FInfo, PBSetFInfo (result of SetFInfo).

name: tc_GetEOF
semantics: FUNCTION GetEOF(refNum; VAR logEOF): OSErr via PBGetEOF; *logEOF=ioMisc (written even on error).

name: tc_SetFPos
semantics: FUNCTION SetFPos(refNum; posMode; posOff): OSErr via PBSetFPos.

name: tc_SetSoundVol
semantics: PROCEDURE SetSoundVol(level): PBControl to Sound Driver refNum -4, csCode 2, csParam=level (PB on stack, other fields uninitialised).

name: tc_CountAppFiles
semantics: PROCEDURE CountAppFiles(VAR message, VAR count): *count=0; if AppParmHandle (0xAEC) size>0: *message=word0, *count=word1.

name: tc_GetAppFiles
semantics: PROCEDURE GetAppFiles(index; VAR theFile): clears fType; if 1<=index<=count copies AppParm entries 1..index into theFile (last = index-th) with entry size 8+((len+2)&~1).

name: tc_PurgeSpace
semantics: PROCEDURE PurgeSpace(VAR total, VAR contig): *total=D0, *contig=A0 from trap A162.

name: tc_FlushInstructionCache
semantics: HWPriv (A198) selector 1.

name: tc_FlushDataCache
semantics: HWPriv (A198) selector 3.

name: tc__Pack2_dispatch
semantics: Inserts selector D2.w under the return address and executes _Pack2 (A9E9).

name: tc_DIBadMount
semantics: FUNCTION DIBadMount(where; evtMessage): INTEGER = Pack2 selector 0 (Disk Initialization dialog). Called by HandleEvent.

name: tc_NumToString
semantics: PROCEDURE NumToString(theNum; VAR theString: Str255): Pack7 selector 0 (A0=str, D0=num).

name: tc_StripAddress
semantics: FUNCTION StripAddress(addr): Ptr; trap A055 if available (ROM85 bit6 clear), else addr & Lo3Bytes (0x31A).

name: tc_HandToHand
semantics: FUNCTION HandToHand(VAR theHndl): OSErr; *theHndl = copy (A0 written even on error).

name: tc_GetIndString
semantics: PROCEDURE GetIndString(VAR theString; strListID; index): theString[0]=0; GetResource('STR#',id); if found and 1<=index<=count copies the index-th Pascal string (len+1 bytes). Resource not released/locked.
